name: Command Re-roll
timing: Before making a dice roll for a unit or model
effect: Re-roll that dice roll. Each dice roll can only be re-rolled once per phase.

name: Counter-offensive
timing: After an enemy unit has fought in the Fight phase, select one of your own eligible units to fight next

name: Grenadiers
timing: When a unit from your army is selected to shoot, before any attacks are resolved
effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack with a Grenade weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

name: Heroic Intervention
timing: After an enemy unit ends a Charge move
effect: Select one unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of any other enemy unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3", but must end that move in Engagement Range of the enemy unit.

name: Rapid Ingress
timing: At the end of your opponent's Movement phase
effect: Select one unit from your army that is in Reserves, and set it up on the battlefield as described by the Reserve rule for that unit. That unit cannot make a Normal move, Advance, Fall Back, or Charge during the current turn.

name: Smokescreen
timing: When an enemy unit targets one of your units with ranged attacks
effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover.
